title: British third thesis: atrocious falls bring paternal anger and damnable guilt
source_text: XIII. Postea vero haec est eorum tertia Thesis: Iidem regeniti & justificati quandoque suo vitio incidunt in atrocia peccata, atque hisce indignationem Dei paternam incurrunt, reatum damnabilem contrahunt, praesentem ad regnum coelorum ingrediendum aptitudinem amittunt.
pass_a_gloss: Afterwards this is their third Thesis: The same regenerate and justified persons sometimes by their own fault fall into atrocious sins, and by these incur the paternal indignation of God, contract damnable guilt, and lose their present fitness for entering the kingdom of heaven.
pass_b_english: Britain’s third thesis: regenerate saints can plunge into atrocious sins by their own fault.
Then they meet paternal wrath, damnable guilt, and loss of present fitness for heaven.

choices.why: Fatherly anger, not mere impersonal fate.
